新增:
我的点赞
「我」页新增「我的点赞」，按帖子和回复分开查看

我的回复
点按「我」页的回帖数，查看自己的回复

图片所在楼层
查看帖子中的图片时显示所在楼层，点按可跳转
改进:
动效
状态切换、展开收起和列表增删的过渡更连贯；跳转到的楼层短暂高亮

跟手
返回、大标题和甩出的图片延续手指的速度；底部导航按下时有弹性

提示
应用内的提示统一为玻璃提示条

切换主题
切换外观、主题色或夜间模式时，颜色渐变过渡

减弱动态效果
开启后不再回弹、缩放和模糊，装饰动画保持静止

首页下拉
展开最近逛的吧后，继续下拉即可刷新

图片加载
网络图片统一淡入显示

标签栏
各页面的标签样式统一，可滚动时边缘淡出

平板
登录、举报等在窗口中央打开；长图居中单列显示；轻扫分栏线可收起列表
修复: 部分 Android 17 系统上，签到时应用崩溃
检查新消息时，应用偶尔卡住
从后台返回后，壁纸有时变黑
网页未经询问写入剪贴板
刷新关注的帖子和消息后，新内容不在顶部
关注和粉丝列表的滚动位置互相影响
没有内容的列表一直显示加载中
消息角标中的两位数显示不全
吧资料页和个人主页加载时没有顶栏
切换精华分类后，吧的帖子数和关注人数改变
下拉刷新个人主页时，加载提示提前消失
快速连续修改设置时，可能保存为旧值
设置项出现或隐藏时，后面的开关状态错位
经典样式下，吧内标签栏无法横向滑动
跟随壁纸取色的应用图标中，镜片仍为蓝色
发送回复后，回复框收起时提示文字闪现
平板横屏时，关闭视频会让屏幕翻转两次
平板上收起的分栏列表无法拉回

New:
Likes
Me has a new Likes page, with threads and replies apart

Your replies
Tap the reply count on Me to see your replies

A picture's floor
Pictures from a thread show the floor they are on; tap it to go there
Improved:
Motion
Changes of state, opening and folding, and rows coming and going move more smoothly; the floor jumped to lights up briefly

Following the finger
Back, large titles and flung pictures carry on at the finger's speed; the bottom navigation gives a little when pressed

Messages
Messages in the app all show as the glass toast

Changing themes
Changing the appearance, accent or night mode fades between the colors

Reduce motion
When on, nothing bounces, zooms or blurs, and decorative animations hold still

Pulling down on Home
Once the recent forums are open, keep pulling to refresh

Loading pictures
Pictures from the network all fade in

Tabs
Tabs look the same on every page and fade out at an edge with more past it

Tablets
Logging in, reporting and the like open in the middle of the window; long pictures show in a centered column; flick the pane divider to fold the list away
Fixed: Signing in to forums crashed on some Android 17 systems
The app sometimes froze while checking for new messages
The wallpaper sometimes turned black after coming back to the app
Web pages wrote to the clipboard without asking
After refreshing followed threads or notifications, the new items weren't at the top
The follows and fans lists shared one scroll position
Lists with nothing in them kept showing loading
Two-digit counts in the message badge were cut off
A forum's details and a profile had no top bar while loading
Switching a forum's class of good threads changed its thread and member counts
Pulling to refresh a profile stopped showing loading too early
Changing a setting quickly several times could store an older value
When a setting row showed or hid, the switches after it showed the wrong state
In the classic style, a forum's tabs couldn't be swiped sideways
With the app icon taking the wallpaper's colors, its lens stayed blue
After sending a reply, the hint flashed as the composer closed
On tablets held sideways, closing a video turned the screen twice
On tablets, a folded-away list couldn't be pulled back out
